name: aricart-install-binary
description: GitHub Action to install a binary from a GitHub Release

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/ && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as _createRequire } from 'module'; const require = _createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.run: npm run build && RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE=./runner/cache RUNNER_TEMP=./runner/temp node dist/index.js
scripts.all: npm run fmt && npm run lint && npm run build

author: aricart
